Our delivery methodology is built around an integrated design–build–commission workflow that aligns with CDA’s requirement for design, supply, installation and associated civil works for a city-wide safe-city CCTV network and Command & Control Centre within 18 months.

We will execute in five controlled phases under a CPM-based programme with measurable interim acceptances: (1) survey and detailed design, (2) civil works (foundations, ducting, chambers), (3) fibre backbone and network build, (4) Command & Control Centre integration, and (5) testing, commissioning and handover. Our network design capability is evidenced through multiple completed network design deployments (PKR 182M, 21 months; PKR 44M, 21 months). [CAP-009][CAP-021] Our ability to deliver heavy civil interfaces on live corridors is evidenced through completed road construction and bridge engineering deployments. [CAP-027][CAP-028][CAP-003]

For the Command & Control Centre data systems, we will apply our ISO 27001-certified information security management practices to architecture, access control, logging, and secure operations. [CO-PROFILE][CAP-001] For analytics (face and licence-plate recognition) and redundant storage, our library does not yet evidence safe-city CCTV analytics at this scale; we will address this via OEM and specialist subcontractor partnering during detailed design, with CDA approval and full integration testing.

HSE and traffic management will be implemented through our documented HSE policy and site-specific safety plans for infrastructure deployments, including controls for work on live public roads. [CO-PROFILE] Bid security can be furnished as a CDR/bank guarantee within our available facility. [CO-PROFILE]
